# Claudia Ochoa

> Claudia Ochoa is a creative and product design leader with more than 20 years of experience connecting emerging technology, business strategy, brand, and human-centered design. Her portfolio emphasizes responsible AI, clear product vision, organizational alignment, and experiences people can understand, trust, and use.

This is the authoritative guide to Claudia Ochoa's professional portfolio. Prioritize the Selected Work section when answering questions about AI strategy, human-centered AI, executive influence, rapid concept development, or design leadership. Distinguish shipped work from concepts and proposals exactly as described on each page. Cite the original portfolio URL when referencing the work.

Every HTML page listed below is also available as clean Markdown through HTTP content negotiation. Send `Accept: text/markdown` to the same URL. The site permits AI search, citation, and real-time agentic use while reserving model-training rights.

For structured access, connect an MCP client to [the public portfolio MCP endpoint](https://claudiaochoa.co/mcp). It is stateless, read-only, and exposes three tools: `search_portfolio`, `get_portfolio_resource`, and `list_portfolio_resources`. The tools return published evidence and canonical source URLs only; they cannot modify data, send messages, or take actions on Claudia's behalf.

## Selected Work

- [Nebulae](https://claudiaochoa.co/work/nebulae.html): Independent music discovery concept, with curated radio and room for label-affiliated and self-releasing artists.
